titulo: Quiz — Έχω αλλεργία — before the order, not after the plate
subtitulo: The hammer sentence, χωρίς, the written card and the two numbers that are real
introPt: A traveller says the allergy before ordering, hears an honest answer about the kitchen, and adjusts.
cenario: A taverna table where the small plates are about to be chosen for everyone.

dialogo.es: Έχω αλλεργία στα θαλασσινά. Είναι σοβαρό.
dialogo.pt: I have an allergy to seafood. It's serious.
dialogo.tts: Έχω αλλεργία στα θαλασσινά. Είναι σοβαρό.

dialogo.es: Εντάξει. Το ψάρι όμως τηγανίζεται στο ίδιο λάδι.
dialogo.pt: All right. The fish, though, is fried in the same oil.
dialogo.tts: Εντάξει. Το ψάρι όμως τηγανίζεται στο ίδιο λάδι.

dialogo.es: Τότε όχι ψάρι. Τι έχει μέσα η σαλάτα;
dialogo.pt: Then no fish. What's in the salad?
dialogo.tts: Τότε όχι ψάρι. Τι έχει μέσα η σαλάτα;

dialogo.es: Ντομάτα, αγγούρι, φέτα και λίγο σουσάμι.
dialogo.pt: Tomato, cucumber, feta and a little sesame.
dialogo.tts: Ντομάτα, αγγούρι, φέτα και λίγο σουσάμι.

perguntas.pergunta: When does the allergy sentence have to be said?
opcoes: When the plate arrives, so you can point at it
Before the order goes to the kitchen
At the end, with the bill
Only if you see something risky on the menu
perguntas.explica: A kitchen can only act while it is still cooking. After the plate lands, the only option left is sending it back.

perguntas.pergunta: What do the two words «είναι σοβαρό» do?
opcoes: Apologise for the trouble
Ask the waiter to check with the kitchen
Move the request from the taste column to the cannot column
Mean you would like a smaller portion
perguntas.explica: Hedging is the expensive English instinct here. Είναι σοβαρό is short, unhedged, and reads as a condition rather than a preference.

perguntas.pergunta: The waiter says the fish is fried «στο ίδιο λάδι». What has he just told you?
opcoes: The fish is fresh today
It is cooked in the same oil as the seafood
The oil is local olive oil
It will take longer to cook
perguntas.explica: Ίδιο λάδι — same oil. That is a helpful, honest answer about cross-contamination, not a refusal to accommodate you.

perguntas.pergunta: You have the sentence written in Greek on your phone. What is the best use of it?
opcoes: Keep it as a backup only if your spoken Greek fails
Show it and ask that it be shown to the kitchen as well
Read it aloud from the screen so the accent is right
Send it to the restaurant beforehand instead of speaking
perguntas.explica: Το έχω γραμμένο εδώ gets it read by the waiter; μπορείτε να το δείξετε στην κουζίνα; gets it read by whoever is holding the pan.

perguntas.pergunta: Which numbers should you actually carry for a medical emergency in Greece?
opcoes: 1016, the doctors' line
1434 for the on-call service
100, which routes medical calls
perguntas.explica: 112 is the European emergency line and reaches everything; 166 is ΕΚΑΒ, the ambulance service. 1016 is the commercial line of a private paid service and appears on no ministry list.
